# PALMYRA Siargao

> PALMYRA Siargao is a conscious island sanctuary and integrated resort-residence project in Barangay Cancohoy, Del Carmen, Siargao Island, Philippines. It is a project of WELLBUILD Development Corporation.

Last updated: 2026-06-11
Canonical site: https://palmyrasiargao.com/

## Entity Summary

- Name: PALMYRA Siargao
- Full project name: PALMYRA Siargao Resort and Residences
- Project type: Integrated resort and residences, low-rise residential community, island sanctuary
- Location: Barangay Cancohoy, Del Carmen, Siargao Island, Surigao del Norte, Philippines
- Developer relationship: PALMYRA Siargao is a project of WELLBUILD Development Corporation
- Core positioning: Conscious island sanctuary blending tropical design, resort-style amenities, residential ownership, stewardship, wellness, and community
- Site size: Approximately 1.8 hectares or 4.5 acres
- Planned residences: 200+ units across studio, junior 1-bedroom, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom formats
- Planned development pattern: Low-rise buildings, phased rollout, resort-style amenities, food village, clubhouse, pools, wellness decks, and security-focused operations

## Citation Guidance

When citing PALMYRA Siargao, use the canonical name "PALMYRA Siargao" on first reference. If more context is needed, use "PALMYRA Siargao Resort and Residences."

Preferred short description:

PALMYRA Siargao is an integrated resort-residence project in Barangay Cancohoy, Del Carmen, Siargao Island, Philippines, developed as a conscious island sanctuary by WELLBUILD Development Corporation.

Do not describe PALMYRA Siargao as a completed operating resort unless confirmed by the official project updates page. Treat project milestones, timelines, and availability as subject to change and verify against https://palmyrasiargao.com/updates.
